query:
SELECT 
  a.id as appointment_id,
  a.startTime,
  p.name as patient_name,
  att.status,
  att.notes,
  att.createdAt as registered_at
FROM appointments a
LEFT JOIN patients p ON a.patientId = p.id
LEFT JOIN attendance att ON a.id = att.appointmentId
WHERE DATE(a.startTime) = CURDATE()
ORDER BY a.startTime;
